meta.title: 在家复刻冰卡布！超简单门店同款做法
meta.title_en: Recreate Iced Cappuccino at Home! A Simple Café-Style Recipe

scenes.context: 做冰卡布的第一步：放150克左右的冰块，六到七分满就够。核心是牛奶的量，浓缩与牛奶的比例大约1比4到1比5。语域：咖啡教学，配方讲解。
sentences: 先放 150 克左右的冰块。
Start with about 150 grams of ice.
about 150 grams（150克左右）
六到七分满就足够了。
Six to seven-tenths full is enough.
seven-tenths full（七分满）
浓缩和牛奶的比例 1 比 4 到 1 比 5。
The ratio is 1 part espresso to 4 or 5 parts milk.
espresso to milk ratio（浓缩与牛奶比例）
scenes.speak: Start with about 150 grams of ice. Six to seven-tenths full is enough. The ratio is 1 part espresso to 4 or 5 parts milk.

scenes.context: 冰卡布不能用蒸汽棒打奶泡，要用奶泡器（手持打发器）。密封状态下压十几次，把气打进去，就变成绵密的奶泡。语域：咖啡教学，工具用法。
sentences: 冰卡布不能用蒸汽棒。
Iced cappuccino doesn't use a steam wand.
steam wand（蒸汽棒）
要用奶泡器手打。
You use a milk frother instead.
milk frother（奶泡器）
密封状态下，压十几次。
Sealed, pump it about ten times.
pump it（压）
paraphrase: 蒸汽棒 → steam wand / steaming rod
奶泡器 → milk frother / hand frother
scenes.speak: Iced cappuccino doesn't use a steam wand. You use a milk frother instead. Sealed, pump it about ten times.

scenes.title_en: Pulling the Shot and the Order
scenes.context: 萃取35克左右的双份浓缩，然后组装：先放冰、再倒牛奶、倒浓缩、最后铺奶泡。顺序可以换，博主喜欢最后放奶泡，这样能看分层。语域：咖啡教学，制作步骤。
sentences: 萃取 35 克左右的双份浓缩。
Pull about 35 grams of double espresso.
double espresso（双份浓缩）
顺序：冰、牛奶、浓缩、奶泡。
Order: ice, milk, espresso, then foam.
then foam（最后奶泡）
最后放奶泡，能看到分层。
Foam last shows off the layers.
shows off the layers（看分层）
scenes.speak: Pull about 35 grams of double espresso. Order: ice, milk, espresso, then foam. Foam last shows off the layers.

scenes.context: 冰卡布上面至少两到三公分都是奶泡，第一口喝到的是绵密的奶泡。跟拿铁的区别：奶泡更绵密，咖啡味道更多一点。语域：咖啡教学，总结对比。
sentences: 上面至少两三公分都是奶泡。
At least 2–3 cm on top is foam.
on top is foam（上面都是奶泡）
第一口喝到绵密的奶泡。
Your first sip is dense, silky foam.
silky foam（绵密奶泡）
比拿铁咖啡味更浓。
It's more coffee-forward than a latte.
coffee-forward（咖啡味更浓）
paraphrase: 绵密 → dense and silky / velvety
咖啡味浓 → coffee-forward / stronger coffee taste
scenes.speak: At least 2–3 cm on top is foam. Your first sip is dense, silky foam. It's more coffee-forward than a latte.

practice: Start with about 150 grams of ice.
Iced cappuccino doesn't use a steam wand.
Order: ice, milk, espresso, then foam.
At least 2–3 cm on top is foam.
pitfalls: Use a steam wand for iced.
Iced cappuccino doesn't use a steam wand.
「冰卡布」用 milk frother，不用蒸汽棒。
Order: ice, milk, espresso, then foam.
It's more coffee-forward than a latte.
Six to seven-tenths full is enough.
「六到七分满」用 six to seven-tenths full。
shifts: 用 espresso（浓缩）、double espresso（双份）、steam wand（蒸汽棒）
用 milk frother（奶泡器）、dense and silky（绵密）、velvety（丝滑）
用 ratio（比例）、pull a shot（萃取）、coffee-forward（咖啡味浓）
